title: Play This: Five Without Freezing
learner_need: Stop freezing when the bar has five beats
immediate_opening_action: PLAY THIS. Strum the rhythm shell five times per bar and say long-short.
likely_loop_ending: So now you know what to do when five-four makes your hand stop.

title: Play This: Melody Targets Over The Vamp
learner_need: Keep the melody from floating away from the pulse
playable_seed: First melody target in each measure, measures 1-8
immediate_opening_action: PLAY THIS. Keep the vamp going in your ear and play only the melody targets.
likely_loop_ending: So now you know where the melody lands inside five.

title: Play This: Name The Shell Before The Chord
learner_need: Understand harmony from voicing content rather than external charts
immediate_opening_action: PLAY THIS. Strum the shell and name the notes before saying the chord name.
likely_loop_ending: So now you know how to trust the voicing before the chart.
